claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled cancer cell viability screen, bergenin is expected to be largely inactive because its characterized activity is anti-inflammatory/antioxidant/PPARgamma agonism without a cytotoxic mechanism at this concentration.
